We view children as curious explorers and active participants in their own learning journey.

A good balance of both, because parents are a child's first educators — and we welcome their input.

A warm, inclusive and joyful atmosphere where children explore, discover and grow at their own pace.

About us

At Little Rainbows Day Nursery, we believe that children learn best when they feel happy, safe, and free to explore through play.

Play is at the heart of everything we do. Through fun, age-appropriate activities and hands-on experiences, children are encouraged to use their imagination, build confidence, solve problems, make friends, and develop important social, emotional, physical, and thinking skills.

We understand that every child is unique and develops at their own pace. Our caring team creates a warm, welcoming, and inclusive environment where children feel supported to explore, discover new interests, and enjoy their learning journey.

Our aim is to help every child grow with confidence, curiosity, and joy while creating happy memories and meaningful friendships along the way.

Our Philosophy

At Little Rainbows Day Nursery, we believe that children learn best when they feel happy, safe, and free to explore through play.

Play is at the heart of everything we do. Through fun, age-appropriate activities and hands-on experiences, children are encouraged to use their imagination, build confidence, solve problems, make friends, and develop important social, emotional, physical, and thinking skills.

We understand that every child is unique and develops at their own pace. Our caring team creates a warm, welcoming, and inclusive environment where children feel supported to explore, discover new interests, and enjoy their learning journey.

Our aim is to help every child grow with confidence, curiosity, and joy while creating happy memories and meaningful friendships along the way.

The EYFS

Our curriculum follows the Early Years Foundation Stage. Six areas, each one an invitation to play.

Art: Offer resources for mixing colours, joining things together and combining materials supporting where appropriate.

Music: Share rhymes books and stories from many cultures.

Movement: Planned activities and in-the-moment activities where children can practice movements in different ways and at different speeds — balancing, target throwing, rolling, kicking and catching.

Language: Provide stories with repetitive phrases and structures to read aloud to children to support specific vocabulary and language structure.

Mathematics: Provide a numerical rich environment — for example in role play areas, numbers on trikes and toilet doors.

Outside Play: Provide time and space to enjoy energetic play outdoors daily.

Health & Safety

At Little Rainbows Day Nursery, we prioritise the health and safety of every child in our care while upholding our ethos of learning through play. Our health and safety policy is designed to create a secure and nurturing environment where children can thrive and explore with confidence. Here are some key components of our health and safety approach:

1. Safe Environment: We aim to make children, parents, staff and volunteers aware of health and safety issues and to minimise the hazards and risks to enable the children to thrive in a healthy and safe environment.

2. Staff Training: We provide a variety of training for our team through our local authorities training program.

3. Hygiene Practices: We promote good hygiene practices among children and staff, including handwashing routines, appropriate sanitation of toys and equipment, and maintaining cleanliness throughout the premises.

4. Allergies and Medical Needs: We work closely with parents and carers to understand and accommodate children's allergies and medical needs, including administering medications as prescribed by healthcare professionals.

Little Rainbows Day Nursery endeavours to remain a place where children can learn, play, and grow.

text:
Parent Testimonials

To all the staff at Little Rainbows,

A huge thank you to all of you for not only taking care of and teaching my little one but for making him feel loved!

He joined Little Rainbows 3 years ago crying because he didn't want to leave my side; he now begs me to come to nursery and leaves every day with a smile :)

He will miss you all every day and I will also miss you all!

Love O's Mummy

To all the teachers in Little Rainbows, it was a pleasure to have you take care of our niece and help her learn and get ready for reception.

Many thanks once again from

N's Auntie & Uncle

Little Rainbows,

Where do I even start? I cannot even begin to say thank you for nurturing and loving my child for these last three and a half years. I remember his first day so clearly and now he's leaving and ready for school ...! How did that happen so quickly? Since the age of 8 months he's been with you! Thank you for allowing me to have endless chats with you most days about how his day has been. I know I'm ‘that’ parent! I just want to let you guys know I am nothing but grateful for all you've done for S. He has always loved nursery and has made a lovely group of friends. I just hope that he is cared for just as well in school.

Thanks again and I will bring S in to see you guys from time to time.

Many Thanks S's Mummy & Daddy

The Little Rainbows team,

I would just like to thank you all for looking after our little ones. You've been nothing but loving and caring towards not just them but us as well, and we thank you for that. We are going to miss seeing their smiles when they walk through the nursery doors.

J's Family

LITTLE RAINBOWS, WE ARE GOING TO MISS YOU!

C & E always talk about going to nursery even on weekends! They never want a break from Little Rainbows! Thank you for making it such a safe, loving and fun environment for them to be in. I couldn't have applied for a better nursery!

C & E's Family

THANK YOU SO MUCH!

For all your patience day to day,
For every tear you wipe away,
For the little hands you gently hold,
For teaching how to share,
For being kind and being there,

YOUR TEAM IS SO WONDERFUL!

T's Mummy

It takes a big heart to help shape a little human. Huge thank you to all the Little Rainbows staff!

V's Daddy and Family :)

text:
ABOUT US
Learning through play for the early years

Little Rainbows Day Nursery believes in fostering a love for learning through play. Our approach combines a professional and fun atmosphere, providing children with a safe and nurturing environment to explore, discover, and grow.

ABOUT OUR CARE
Where every child comes first

We understand that every child is unique and develops at their own pace. Our caring team creates a warm, welcoming, and inclusive environment where children feel supported to explore, discover new interests, and enjoy their learning journey.

Explore our curriculum
HEALTH & SAFETY
A secure environment to explore with confidence
Safe Environment

We aim to make children, parents, staff and volunteers aware of health and safety issues and to minimise the hazards and risks to enable the children to thrive in a healthy and safe environment.

Staff Training

We provide a variety of training for our team through our local authorities training program.

Hygiene Practices

We promote good hygiene practices among children and staff, including handwashing routines, appropriate sanitation of toys and equipment, and maintaining cleanliness throughout the premises.

Allergies and Medical Needs

We work closely with parents and carers to understand and accommodate children's allergies and medical needs, including administering medications as prescribed by healthcare professionals.

“At Little Rainbows Day Nursery, we believe that children learn best when they feel happy, safe, and free to explore through play.”

LITTLE RAINBOWS PHILOSOPHY

OUR STAFF
A caring, supported team

We provide a variety of training for our team through our local authorities training program.

At Little Rainbows Day Nursery, we prioritise the health and safety of every child in our care while upholding our ethos of learning through play. Our health and safety policy is designed to create a secure and nurturing environment where children can thrive and explore with confidence. Here are some key components of our health and safety approach:

OUR PUBLISHED COMMITMENTS

A TYPICAL DAY
Learning through play throughout the day
01
Art

Offer resources for mixing colours, joining things together and combining materials supporting where appropriate.

02
Music

Share rhymes books and stories from many cultures.

03
Movement

Planned activities and in-the-moment activities where children can practice movements in different ways and at different speeds — balancing, target throwing, rolling, kicking and catching.

04
Language

Provide stories with repetitive phrases and structures to read aloud to children to support specific vocabulary and language structure.

05
Mathematics

Provide a numerical rich environment — for example in role play areas, numbers on trikes and toilet doors.

06
Outside Play

Provide time and space to enjoy energetic play outdoors daily.

Come and see us for yourself

Our aim is to help every child grow with confidence, curiosity, and joy while creating happy memories and meaningful friendships along the way.

Check availability
